name: Diamond Push-up
how_to:
Step 1: Setup and Starting Position
- Start in a high plank position, keeping your hands directly under your chest.
- Bring your hands close together, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
- Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core and glutes to maintain stability.
Step 2: Execution
- Lower your chest toward the diamond shape formed by your hands.
- Keep your elbows close to your body to maximize triceps engagement.
- Lower yourself until your chest nearly touches your hands.
- Press back up to the starting position by extending your arms fully.
- Repeat for 3 to 4 sets of 10 to 15 reps, depending on your strength level.
